{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It's a bit, it's a bit dramatic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:18.920

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:25.720
    | text      = And then, I mean, watching the younglings get torn apart by our future Darth.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:32.360
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:33.360
    | text      = Chase Geyser is going to have to kill the younglings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:35.360
    | text      = Is Chase our Anakin in this scenario?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:37.439
    | text      = Oh man, that's brutal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:38.439

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = He really does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:42.839
    | text      = He really knows how to nail whining.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:45.279
    | text      = So Alex, this was really what grabbed me about this episode.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:49.199
    | text      = I turned it on and I was like, okay, Alex is, he's in a particular mood and maybe one
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:54.839
    | text      = we haven't really ever seen on him before.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:57.879
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:58.879
    | text      = And you might describe it as euphoria.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:00.160
    | text      = Interesting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:01.160
    | text      = But he's not on drugs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:02.160
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:03.160
    | text      = Well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:04.160
    | text      = He should do drugs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:06.519
    | text      = I'm not on drugs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:07.519
    | text      = I've had a cup of coffee this morning, didn't eat breakfast and worked out for an hour and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:12.160
    | text      = 15 minutes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:13.160
    | text      = And about 10 minutes before I went on air, I was just hit with euphoria.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:18.439
    | text      = I'm hiring a kite right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:21.079
    | text      = I told the crew, I said, I'm not even going to be able to do the show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:23.240
    | text      = I don't know what.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:24.240
    | text      = I don't feel total euphoria.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:25.240
    | text      = This is weird.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:27.160
    | text      = I have a few times I was like three or four years old.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:29.480
    | text      = I have early memories of just all this having euphoria walking around the backyard of the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:34.240
    | text      = house or whatever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:37.039
    | text      = And that's kind of how I feel right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:38.620
    | text      = And then I was analyzing it right as we were going live two minutes ago and I went, I felt
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:45.360
    | text      = a disturbance in the force.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:47.559
    | text      = The last time I felt it was in the presence of my old master.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:51.639
    | text      = And I really started thinking about what was I intellectually thinking getting ready for
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:55.480
    | text      = the show?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:57.759
    | text      = What was the understanding I had?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:01.960
    | text      = And it was that the enemy is defeated, they're being crushed and everything they do is failing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:06.200
    | text      = and the tide is totally turned and a great weight lifted off of me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:10.960
    | text      = That's what it is when you get hit with something so huge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:14.720
    | text      = And I was going to come on air and explain that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:17.039
    | text      = And I literally stumbled in there to talk to Ben because he'll type out what I want
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:21.720
    | text      = for the live show headlines.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:25.399
    | text      = Because I was God-smacked, I guess is the word they use for it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:30.000
    | text      = Is this what being God-smacked, pull up the definition of God-smacked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:35.000
    | text      = Really we're doing that, huh?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:39.120
    | text      = It happened about seven, eight minutes before I went live at about 10, 53, I get a cup of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:47.159
    | text      = coffee and I walk in here to the studio, I'd already been getting ready earlier.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:51.159
    | text      = And I just started like, Whoa, I'm having euphoria.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:55.159
    | text      = Someone slipped some LSD in his coffee.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:58.159
    | text      = So I mean, wouldn't that be fun?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = What's the difference?

    | text      = Well, I mean, that's preferable.

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Either way, and no matter what the case, you're not safe.

    | text      = No, that's true.

    | text      = Probably.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = And great impressions.
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:18.619

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:19.980
    | text      = However, the number is not in reference to lost children.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:23.940
    | text      = There were 448,820 unaccompanied children admitted to the United States between October

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:37.179
    | text      = Basically, it goes like this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:39.880
    | text      = When unaccompanied minors arrive at the border, they're handed off from ICE to the Department

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = of Health and Human Services, specifically the Office of Refugee Resettlement.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:49.820

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:53.820
    | text      = or an approved sponsor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:55.900

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:00.139
    | text      = begun against them, which is handled by ICE.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = ICE did not contact those 291,000 children because they didn't begin removal proceedings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:09.019

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:16.900

{{TranscriptBlock
